Verses (full text)

50:3 · 050 Qaf

أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ

Word in this verse: رَجْعٌۢ — (is) a return

English (Sahih International): When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return."

English (Yusuf Ali): "What! When we die and become dust, (shall we live again?) That is a (sort of) return far (from our understanding)."

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): بھلا جب ہم مر گئے اور مٹی ہوگئے (تو پھر زندہ ہوں گے؟) یہ زندہ ہونا (عقل سے) بعید ہے

86:8 · 086 At-Tariq

إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ

Word in this verse: رَجْعِهِۦ — return him

English (Sahih International): Indeed, He [i.e., Allāh], to return him [to life], is Able.

English (Yusuf Ali): Surely (Allah) is able to bring him back (to life)!

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): بےشک خدا اس کے اعادے (یعنی پھر پیدا کرنے) پر قادر ہے

86:11 · 086 At-Tariq

وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ

Word in this verse: ٱلرَّجْعِ — returns

English (Sahih International): By the sky which sends back

English (Yusuf Ali): By the Firmament which returns (in its round),

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): آسمان کی قسم جو مینہ برساتا ہے
